mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_transactions (user_id, text, amount, type, category_id, frequency, next_due_date, is_active, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{text}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{categoryId}, #{frequency}, #{nextDueDate}, #{isActive}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_transactions SET text = #{text}, amount = #{amount}, type = #{type}, category_id = #{categoryId}, frequency = #{frequency}, next_due_date = #{nextDueDate}, is_active = #{isActive}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recurring_transactions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.name as categoryName FROM recurring_transactions r LEFT JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY r.next_due_date ASC

SELECT r.*, c.name as categoryName FROM recurring_transactions r LEFT JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_active = TRUE AND r.next_due_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY r.next_due_date ASC

SELECT text, type, ROUND(AVG(ABS(amount)), 2) AS avgAmount, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, ROUND( DATEDIFF(MAX(date), MIN(date)) / GREATEST(COUNT(*) - 1, 1) ) AS avgIntervalDays, MAX(date) AS lastDate FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY text, type, ROUND(ABS(amount) / 15) * 15 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND ROUND( DATEDIFF(MAX(date), MIN(date)) / GREATEST(COUNT(*) - 1, 1) ) BETWEEN 6 AND 400 ORDER BY occurrences DESC, avgAmount DESC LIMIT 20
